findings.explanation: Trailing '&& false' makes isOutsideAllowedWindowMessengerError() always return false regardless of the actual code/subcode match, so it's dead code. Contrast with isRecipientUnavailableMessengerError() (line 32, code 551/subcode 1545041) which correctly returns true and is treated as non-retryable. Because of this bug, code 10 errors (outside 24h messaging window / missing permission) are never classified as non-retryable in isNonRetryableMessengerSendError() (line 42) or getMessengerSendBlockReason() (line 47). Callers in core/webhook.js (lines 607, 633, 782, 800, 1066) fall through to the generic 'throw err' / retry path for code 10, causing permanently-undeliverable messages (window already closed) to be requeued and retried indefinitely instead of being dropped like the 551 case, unlike 613 (rate limit) which legitimately should backoff-retry. This nullifies the intended 3-way differentiation between code 10, 551, and 613 described in the audit.
